title: Gear Train
reference: repeat 4 { F2 } def F1 { repeat 3 { forward } activate } def F2 { F1 F1 turn_right }
hints: A big ring of gears with two switches on every side, and main has only two slots.
F1 walks three and switches; a loop inside it saves a slot. F2 is a side: F1, F1, turn.
